question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Focus** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Focus **means to concentrate on something. (किसी चीज़ पर ध्यान केंद्रित करना) • **Example**: *The company decided to focus its resources on innovation and product development to stay competitive in the dynamic market.* • The word "focus" is appropriate in the given sentence because it conveys the idea that the strategies of the 12th plan are centered or concentrated on various aspects of higher education. • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Understand **means to comprehend or grasp the meaning of something. (किसी बात का अर्थ समझना) • **Attend **means to be present at an event or pay attention to something. (किसी कार्यक्रम में उपस्थित होना या किसी चीज़ पर ध्यान देना) • **Divert **means to turn something aside or redirect it. (किसी चीज़ को एक ओर मोड़ना या पुनर्निर्देशित करना) 45:Ta3c, The correct answer is: **Coordinated**.
